description: This header file declares functions and macros for converting legacy iControl trigger rules, constraints, actions, and schedules into Sheens-based JavaScript state machine nodes. It facilitates the transformation of legacy rule formats into JavaScript code structures for the Sheens engine.
external_methods: cJSON* sheens_trigger2javascript(const icrule_trigger_t*, const char*, const char*, cJSON*, cJSON*)
cJSON* sheens_negative2javascript(const icrule_trigger_list_t*, const icrule_constraint_time_t*, cJSON*)
cJSON* sheens_actions2javascript(const uint64_t, icLinkedListIterator*, cJSON*, cJSON*)

methods.name: sheens_trigger2javascript
methods.description: Converts an iControl legacy trigger into a Sheens JavaScript node, possibly generating multiple nodes for complex patterns.

methods.name: sheens_negative2javascript
methods.description: Transforms a list of negative triggers into Sheens JavaScript nodes for the state machine.

methods.name: sheens_constraints2javascript
methods.description: Recursively converts legacy constraints into Sheens JavaScript, producing code by processing nested RPN lists.

methods.name: sheens_actions2javascript
methods.description: Converts legacy actions into Sheens JavaScript nodes, generating the corresponding JS code.

methods.name: sheens_schedules2javascript
methods.description: Transforms thermostat schedules into Sheens JavaScript nodes for the engine.
